D: A half-vampire hunter wages war on the vampires who secretly run the city.
P: Serve the snacks when Whistler hands Blade a fresh batch of garlic serum.
S: Whistler's garlic serum that keeps Blade going
Baguette split and spread with butter packed with roasted garlic, parsley and parmesan, baked at 200C for 12 minutes until crisp.
the blood rave where the sprinklers rain blood
Beetroot roasted in foil at 200C for an hour, peeled and blitzed with yoghurt, garlic, lemon and cumin until deep red, with warm pita crisps.

Rump and capsicum skewers marinated in garlic, oregano and lemon, grilled hot and fast, with a sharp garlic aioli. Cut 800g rump into 3cm cubes and marinate with 4 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano, the juice of 1 lemon, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt for 1 hour. Thread onto 8 skewers with chunks of 2 red capsicums and 1 red onion. Grill over high heat for 2 minutes a side. Mix 150g mayo with 2 crushed garlic cloves and a squeeze of lemon to serve.
M: Rib eye seared and basted in butter with a whole head of crushed garlic, with garlic mash and greens.

Beef chuck simmered for hours with kidney beans, chipotle and a whole head of garlic, with sour cream and buttery cornbread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and a whole head of chopped garlic, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 chopped chipotles in adobo, 2 cans crushed tomatoes, 500ml beef stock and the beef. Cover and simmer 2.5 hours, adding 2 cans kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Mix 200g cornmeal, 150g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs, 300ml milk and 80g melted butter and bake at 200C for 22 minutes.
W: Sweet pastry blind baked, filled with a blood orange curd and set, topped with candied blood orange slices.
K: the blood rave where the sprinklers rain red

Red wine steeped with blood orange, pomegranate and cinnamon, topped with soda over ice, deep red and dangerously easy to drink. In a big jug, mix 750ml red wine, 250ml pomegranate juice, 60ml brandy, 2 tbsp caster sugar and 1 cinnamon stick. Add 2 sliced blood oranges and the seeds of half a pomegranate. Chill for at least 2 hours. Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with 300ml soda water. For a booze-free jug, swap the wine and brandy for cranberry juice.

s.note: Whistler's garlic serum that keeps Blade going
s.how: Roast a whole head of garlic at 200C for 40 minutes, then squeeze into 100g soft butter with chopped parsley and grated parmesan. Split a baguette, spread thickly and bake at 200C for 12 minutes until crisp. Keeps certain guests away.

s.note: the blood rave where the sprinklers rain blood
s.how: Wrap 3 beetroot in foil and roast at 200C for an hour, then peel. Blitz with 200g Greek yoghurt, a garlic clove, lemon juice and a pinch of cumin until deep red and smooth. Serve with warm pita cut into wedges and baked crisp.

m.how: Sear 4 rib eye steaks in a hot pan, then add butter and a whole head of crushed garlic and baste for 2 minutes. Rest. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with more butter and roasted garlic. Serve with steamed broccolini. No vampires at this table.

w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case. Whisk the juice of 4 blood oranges, 150g sugar, 3 eggs, 2 tbsp cornflour and 80g butter over heat until thick. Pour into the case and chill to set. Top with blood orange slices simmered in sugar syrup.
